intent_contract.text: 첨부한 이미지의 외모에 어울리는 주사기를 든 얀데레 간호사 컨셉 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘.
첨부한 이미지는 얼굴만 참고하고 구도는 자유롭게 해줘.

Create a photorealistic, non-graphic romantic-obsession nurse concept whose behavior visibly targets one adult beloved patient, while using the attached image only for the adult nurse's facial appearance and leaving composition open.

Photorealistic cinematic portrait of an unmistakably adult woman nurse in a dim private recovery room, using only the attached face as appearance reference: delicate oval face, pale luminous skin, long ash-blonde hair with wispy bangs, gray-brown eyes, softly glossy pink lips. This is a controlled romantic-obsession scene centered on her one adult beloved patient, the only other person in frame. After he reaches toward the bedside call button, she calmly moves it just beyond his fingertips while holding a capped syringe upright in her other hand; the displaced button now rests visibly out of reach. A gentle professional smile remains on her face, but possessive devotion leaks through the white-knuckled grip on his chart. The same adult patient's wrist and call-button reach remain visible. Photorealistic cinematic editorial, waist-up oblique framing, 50mm, shallow depth of field, clinical white uniform, cold teal fluorescent light crossed by muted red monitor glow, natural skin texture, no injection, no blood, no injury, no text, no watermark.
